card.name: Start of brand names beginning with A
card.fires_on: The letter A that opens a drug brand or generic name (AXTLE, AYVAKIT, ALECENSA, ADEMPAS, axitinib) right after a word like administer, of, for, or with. It marks the first piece of a name that continues on the next piece.

modes.description: The first piece A of an all-caps brand name in dosing or prescribing text.
